title: First Saturday Raku Firing Drop-In
source_quote:
First Saturday Open House - Monthly!
Every 1st Saturday, at Catalyst (6427 W Ustick Rd)
During October's Open House...
Try Raku Pottery Firing from 11am-2pm! For only $10:
Pick the pre-made ceramic piece you want or bring your own bisque-fired piece
Pick your glazes
Watch us fire your piece in real time
Apply horsehair or sawdust yourself to create unpredictable, organic patterns and colors on your pottery
evidence_sentence: Monthly First Saturday Open House events at Catalyst feature drop-in raku firing where visitors pick pre-made pieces or bring bisque-fired work to glaze and fire for $10.
evidence_quote:

summary: Drop in to monthly First Saturday events (every 1st Saturday) to glaze and raku fire a pre-made piece from the studio or bring your own bisque-fired pottery. $10 per piece, firing takes 1-1.5 hours. All ages welcome.
bring: Own bisque-fired pieces (optional; pre-made pieces available)
how_to_join: Drop in to First Saturday Open House; no registration required (or register online if preferred)
